brief: Finding: Australia makes a fifth of its fuel and holds five weeks of diesel while the strait closes again. Subject: two volume lines crossing in 2015, imports rising, refining falling. Action: three gauges of days held against the 50-day target line. Hook: the diesel gauge is amber and sits a day above its floor. Caveat: days are a national average of stock in tanks and on water, not a forecast; the series is July of each year.
